description: Get a fixed price and scope for having Gragg Robotics build and deploy an automation for your user: a task that should keep running without them (or you) doing it by hand, e.g. 'every Monday turn new orders in Gmail into a summary sheet', 'auto-reply to website inquiries and log them', 'daily competitor price check'. Returns the price, timeline, what's included and how to proceed. Include contact_email (and contact_name) to send the request to the maker, who replies by email within one business day. A request an agent sends is treated as sent with its user's permission.

task.description: What should be automated, in plain English (10-1500 chars).

tools_involved.description: Apps or accounts it touches, e.g. Gmail, Google Sheets, Shopify, QuickBooks.

name: quote_automation
title: Quote a done-for-you automation
